item.text: The scan currently analyzes all lockfiles as one batch, and CVE entries are overwritten when the same ID appears again. I’m changing the scan to analyze each file separately and carry its path through the finding so reporting can select the right version.

package library

import (
	"os"

	ptypes "github.com/aquasecurity/go-dep-parser/pkg/types"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/detector/library/bundler"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/detector/library/cargo"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/detector/library/composer"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/detector/library/node"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/detector/library/python"
	"github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/types"
	"github.com/knqyf263/go-version"
)

type Driver interface {
	ParseLockfile(*os.File) ([]ptypes.Library, error)
	Detect(string, *version.Version) ([]types.DetectedVulnerability, error)
	Type() string
}

type Factory interface {
	NewDriver(filename string) Driver
}

type DriverFactory struct{}

func (d DriverFactory) NewDriver(filename string) Driver {
	// TODO: use DI
	var scanner Driver
	switch filename {
	case "Gemfile.lock":
		scanner = bundler.NewScanner()
	case "Cargo.lock":
		scanner = cargo.NewScanner()
	case "composer.lock":
		scanner = composer.NewScanner()
	case "package-lock.json":
		scanner = node.NewScanner(node.ScannerTypeNpm)
	case "yarn.lock":
		scanner = node.NewScanner(node.ScannerTypeYarn)
	case "Pipfile.lock":
		scanner = python.NewScanner(python.ScannerTypePipenv)
	case "poetry.lock":
		scanner = python.NewScanner(python.ScannerTypePoetry)
	default:
		return nil
	}
	return scanner
}

item.text: The dependency versions in this checkout predate the required `AnalyzeFile` and error returning driver APIs. Cached local versions provide both, and the scan and report packages compile with them. I’m adding regression coverage for two lockfiles that contain the same library at different versions.

item.text:
Updated the scanner to analyze each lockfile separately and carry its path into vulnerability findings. Reports now use both path and library name to show the correct version, and duplicate CVEs retain findings from every affected lockfile. I also added the in-memory file info implementation and error handling for unknown lockfile types.

The required analyzer and driver APIs came from locally cached dependency versions. Regression tests cover two lockfiles with different versions, CVE merging, and report output. `go test ./...` passes.
